theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

top_news.title: Parents Spend $95K on Gap Years to Give Their Kids an Edge
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Sarah Foster joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." Gap years are becoming more appealing as families question whether a college degree alone is enough to stand out, with some programs costing more than a year of tuition. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Trump Allows Tariff Relief for Some Ground Beef Imports
top_news.summary: President Donald Trump is aiming to deliver cost relief for some ground beef imports to lower prices for American consumers, by allowing up to 300,000 metric tons of product for ground beef to be imported with no out of quota tariff for the next 90 days. He also made a commitment that the beef will be sold at 25% below current market prices. Agriculture Reporter Ilena Peng and Howard Capital Management CEO Vance Howard -- who owns a ranch of his own -- discuss how much the tariff relief will imp

top_news.title: 'Jerry Maguire’ Inspiration on Lakers, Sports Valuations
top_news.summary: Leigh Steinberg, legendary sports agent and founder of the Leigh Steinberg Foundation, spoke about the unprecedented valuations in the sports industry, highlighting the ongoing Los Angeles Lakers sale currently valued at $12.5 billion. He emphasized the dramatic increase in franchise values over the decades, noting that when he started in 1976, NFL expansion teams were purchased for $16.5 million, compared to recent sales reaching into the billions. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close."

top_news.title: Boxing Legend Mike Tyson on Career, Sugar Factory Launch
top_news.summary: Former Heavyweight Champion Mike Tyson discussed his new business venture partnering with Sugar Factory to produce high-protein sliders available in grocery stores. Tyson emphasized the health benefits of these sliders compared to typical frozen options that often contain unhealthy seed oils and excessive grams of fat. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Learning from Buffett and Munger | Masters in Business with Alex Morris
top_news.summary: Barry speaks with Alex Morris, author of Buffett and Munger unscripted. They discuss his research in Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger's annual shareholder meetings. They discuss the challenges in interpreting the market. Alex also discusses other lessons from Berkshire Hathaway. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Citadel Offloads Risk From Situational Awareness
top_news.summary: Ken Griffin's Citadel has offloaded more than 80% of the aggregate risk associated with the Situational Awareness stock portfolio it acquired from the embattled AI hedge fund. Citadel struck a deal last month to buy stocks from the fund led by Leopold Aschenbrenner. Bloomberg's Hema Parmar reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: SEC Accuses Ex-BofA Senior Banker Satsky of Insider Trading
top_news.summary: Former senior Bank of America Corp. investment banker Jason Satsky passed on confidential information about a deal to a friend who made $18.5 million in illegal profits, according to the US Securities and Exchange Commission.

top_news.title: Goldman's Struyven: Hedge Crude's Swings with Diesel
top_news.summary: Daan Struyven, Goldman Sachs Co-Head of Global Commodities Research, discussed the market reaction to potential new US sanctions on Iran during a live financial news segment. He noted that oil prices experienced only a modest increase following the announcement, largely because the existing blockade on Iranian ports and oil exports is already restricting Iranian oil from reaching the market. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Sally Bakewell on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Hobbies Are Winning the Battle for Americans’ Paychecks
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Julia Franzares joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss how consumers of all ages are making more room for pastimes in their budget, with hobbyists willing to cut elsewhere or dip into their savings to fund their hobbies. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Millennials Feel Good About Their Finances, the Data Show Why
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Sarah Foster joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." Almost half of US millennials say their financial situation has improved from five years ago. That compares with 43% of Generation X and 40% of baby boomers who say the same. (Source: Bloomberg)
